title: check critic is active in every project, so check all fails in one that is not an Intent project
body:
## Problem

`check critic` runs Intent's critic, and devbin activates it in every project: it is catalogued `any` (`lib/builtins:112`), so `project_speaks` turns it on, and it is not in `_DEVBIN_BUILTIN_NOT_IN_ALL` (`lib/builtins:170`), so `check all` runs it. Nothing asks whether the project is an Intent project at all. In one that is not -- a legitimate consumer, and some consumers are delivered to clients -- `check critic` dies naming Intent's own remedy (`lib/cmd/check:88`, `require_tool intent`, or `:103-104`, "no config at .../intent/.config/config.json -- run this from an Intent project root"), and `check all` fails with it. The page records the workaround (`lib/pages/check.md:18`: "A project with no Intent config fails it, so disable it there"), the starter config does not apply it (`lib/cmd/install:61-82`), and the suite's own fixture disables critic itself (`tests/unit/dispatch.bats:620`). Parked at the 0.1.8 cut; fixed forward in the bundle on hv's word, 2026-10-03.

## Measured at 2ce9411 (0152 v1 on 953d040; cc's evidence pass)

A fresh `install --name demo` into a git repository with no `intent/`: `check critic` exits 1 with the "no config at" message, or with `intent` off PATH, "intent not found. Install Intent...". `check all` exits 1: "3 of 8 check options ran; 5 inactive ... FAILED: critic", format and toolchain having passed. `doctor` exits 0. With `critic: enabled: false` declared, `check all` exits 0.

## Fix

Critic is INACTIVE where it cannot apply, so it is counted as inactive and `help --why` gives the reason (D11), rather than failing. One table beside `_DEVBIN_BUILTIN_NOT_IN_ALL` names what an option needs in the tree -- `check.critic` needs `intent/` -- `option_active` consults it, and `option_unavailable_reason` says it in one sentence, naming the declaration that runs it anyway. It keys on `intent/`, never on `config.json`, so an Intent project that has lost its config keeps today's loud diagnosis. `docs.agents` has the same shape (`lib/builtins:123`) and is checked against the same table.

## Done when

1. With no `intent/`, `check all` exits 0 and counts critic inactive, and `check critic` exits 2 naming `intent/`; both red at 2ce9411.
2. With `intent/` present and its config missing, `check critic` still fails loudly naming the config.
3. A declared `commands.check.options.critic` runs it regardless.
4. The page loses its workaround sentence and says what the gate needs instead.

## Resolution

Fixed at 627e3948. `check critic` and `docs agents` are inactive in a project with no `intent/` directory, through one table of what a built-in option needs in the tree (`_DEVBIN_BUILTIN_NEEDS`), which `option_active` consults. `all` counts them inactive, and `help --why` says why, naming the declaration that runs them anyway. The table keys on the directory, never on Intent's config, so an Intent project that has lost its config still fails loudly; a directory or a link counts, a file does not, and the question is asked of the project root.

Against the done-when list:

1. With no `intent/`, `check all` exits 0 and counts critic inactive, and `check critic` exits 2 naming `intent/`: dispatch.bats's first (0156) arm, red on the code beneath this change.
2. With `intent/` present and its config missing, `check critic` still fails loudly naming the config: an arm with a stub `intent` on PATH, held by a mutant since the base already did this.
3. A declared `commands.check.options.critic` runs it regardless: an arm asserting the critic's own refusal.
4. check.md loses its workaround sentence and says what the gate needs; docs.md, README, the reference config and the configuration guide say the same of `any`.

Evidence. 11 mutants, all killed. The arms run green under GNU coreutils, findutils and sed as well as the BSD tools. The full suite on the landing tree: on main 962e0daf with 0157 v2.1, 0158 v2.2 and 0156 v2.1 applied in that order, in a fresh clone: 2159 of 2159 ok, 0 not ok, its .errors empty (seal 20261005-1749), 17:49:31Z to 18:37:10Z; 5 skipped, the same five as cc's.
